There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer strategy poses a significant competitive threat by disrupting the traditional automotive sales model. By eliminating dealership markups, they can offer lower prices, which may erode our market share if we remain reliant on traditional dealership networks. Furthermore, their direct engagement provides them with first-party data on consumer behavior, allowing for more agile and targeted marketing and product development. To mitigate this impact, we should consider accelerating our own digital transformation efforts, exploring hybrid sales models, or enhancing the value proposition of our current dealership partners through superior service and customer experience.
